pre_registration.data: Alpaca IEX 5-min bars, regular session 09:30-15:59 ET
pre_registration.costs: 3 bps/side + 0.1 bps fee + 0.05% slippage round trip
pre_registration.config: SPY filter on (vs_open, flat 0.15% -> no breakout trades), 0.5% risk, 1R stop, 2.5R day target, BE after +1R, stair trail peak-0.5R, decay 12 bars, flatten 15:50 ET, max 5 open, max 5 new/day, max 2/sector, 60% net exposure, 2% daily loss cap, 25% notional cap, window 10:00-15:45 ET
pre_registration.fills: signal at bar i fills at next bar open (same day only)
pre_registration.pass_bar: PF >= 1.0 AND avg R > 0 on BOTH train and test, soup PF > random median PF in both periods, >= 20 trades total
pre_registration.random_control: 20 seeded draws (seeds 1-20), same per-symbol-day signal counts, random bars/sides, SPY filter + caps apply
